mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (document_id, chunk_index, content, start_offset, end_offset, embedding_json) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{content}, #{startOffset}, #{endOffset}, #{embeddingJson})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.document_id, c.chunk_index, c.content, c.start_offset, c.end_offset, c.embedding_json FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.id = c.document_id WHERE d.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} ORDER BY c.document_id, c.chunk_index
